remarks:
Charm & Opportunity in North Buffalo NY!
Welcome to 112 Carmel Road. Nestled in one of Buffalo’s most vibrant, high-demand neighborhoods, this classic 1920s double offers an exceptional opportunity for both savvy investors looking to add a high-performing asset to their portfolio or owner-occupants wanting a spacious home where a tenant helps pay the mortgage.  
Boasting an incredible 92/100 Walk Score, this property puts you just moments away from local favorite dining, shopping, parks, and community hubs.  
Sprawling Living Spaces - 
With a generous 2,969 sq. ft. of total living space divided over two distinct units, there is no shortage of room here. The property features 14 total rooms, configured as 1, 3bed 2 bath apartment and 1 2bed 1 bath apartment, ensuring comfortable, flexible living arrangements for everyone.
Whether you are looking to invest in a historically strong rental market or plant roots in a walkable, dynamic Buffalo community, 112 Carmel Road is ready for its next owner.
Features: Forced air heating · Stainless Steel Appliances included in both units · Complete tear off roof 2017 · Lower unit has central air · Lower kitchen has granite countertops and luxury plank flooring · Lower unit has an in unit laundry room with washer and dryer · First floor bathroom has a tiled shower, jacuzzi tub, and tile flooring · Large backyard deck · Upper hardwood floors refinished 2022 · Upper kitchen has newer cabinets and granite countertops · Upper kitchen has stainless steel refrigerator and stove 2022 · Upper kitchen has luxury plank flooring 2022 · Both units feature modern furnaces · Vinyl siding · Modern electrical boxes · Basement water proofed 2022
